# Final OpenTemplateClosure independent review

CLEAN: complete final source, four-probe/four-caller audit, entire guarded checker and exact run6 evidence reviewed. The reviewer did not run Lean or rerun the checker. The author run6 PASS, its 58 before/after inputs, all actual selected providers and the fresh object were independently rehashed.

The exact full source retains the prior reviewed freshness/closure argument. Generalization reserves fresh coordinates by shifting existing internal free parameters; q/shift/free substitution preserves index order, including the two-variable caller. The callback covers every external finite buffer. Internal predicates may retain arbitrary additional free parameters; only the ordinary source free-variable range is bound. No FVFree or shift-fixed assumption is introduced.

The later source normalization uses the exact `0+fvSup` arity produced by fixitr, rather than asking Lean to identify that type definitionally with fvSup. The shift count and fresh-vector length are changed together to the same equal natural number. This is a type-normalization repair, not an extra binder or parameter. The callback at `0+fvSup` is still available under the original forall-b premise. The endpoint and its mathematics remain unchanged.

The final audit change adds only `noncomputable section` for Type-valued internal proof carriers; no proposition or caller hypothesis changed. Run5's source PASS/audit FAIL remains a nonpass. Run6 independently bound here is the first complete source/audit PASS: 4 probes, 4 callers, standard axioms only, zero warnings.

The checker freezes exact source/audit and parent evidence, validates the 16-project import closure and seven external boundaries against source/object hashes, validates pinned compiler/dependency state, selects the actual namespace providers, and checks actual first Init/Omega. It uses a fresh external output, snapshots inputs, compiles only the new module and audit with 4GiB/one thread, then rehashes all selected inputs and the fresh object. It rebuilds/downloads no dependency and does not attest the entire Foundation cache.

This is a finite ordinary-source template-closure module, not an arbitrary internal sourceproof compiler, schema provider, Collection theorem or numerical/binary endpoint. All prior failed attempts must remain separately archived; no source-only or partial-source pass is promoted to the final complete pass.

activity: Independent source/audit/guard read and original-evidence/provider/fresh-object rehash only; no reviewer Lean/checker replay.
